title: Clinical Reliability of AI-Based Cephalometric Analysis Using WebCeph: A Comparative Agreement Study.
summary: WebCeph AI cephalometric measurements compared with clinician measurements using agreement analysis. Results quantifies agreement/reliability for measured landmarks; comparison is clinical measurement validation, not treatment outcome.
ai_technology: WebCeph AI cephalometric measurements compared with clinician measurements using agreement analysis.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: WebCeph AI cephalometric measurements compared with clinician measurements using agreement analysis. Results quantifies agreement/reliability for measured landmarks; comparison is clinical measurement validation, not treatment outcome.
evidence.unknown: On 100 radiographs, automated values differed significantly from manual tracing for six of seven measures, with inconsistent and often poor agreement; the study does not establish clinical interchangeability.
